balls.text: back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Dhoni has a massive heave at it and drags it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single to end the innings but CSK end on 223-3!
full and way outside off stump. Dhoni leaves it alone as the umpire indulges in some more exercise

safe! But it is a No ball, oh dear! Full toss on off stump. Dhoni miscues it and it lands in the vacant mid wicket region. The batters want to refer it for height but in the meantime, the third umpire intimates that Sakariya has overstepped!
yorker outside off stump. Jadeja drills it towards long off, and someone seems to have turned up the volume in Delhi because...Dhoni is back on strike
slower bumper just outside off stump. Jadeja does not quite pick it early enough and his attempt to upper cut it goes in vain

slower delivery hung way outside off stump. Too wide, in fact. Jadeja lets it go as the umpire calls it a wide. DC have reviewed this, although it might be more in hope than anticipation. The third umpire has a look at it and says the original call was right. Wide given!
shot! Another low full toss, although this one is way outside off. Jadeja gets down on one knee, fetches it and gets it past the fielder in the circle at square leg!
but it does not matter! Low full toss at the stumps. Jadeja gets his front foot out of the way and razes it past deep mid wicket for four!
yorker outside off stump. Dhoni can only squeeze it out towards long on for a single
four more! Slower delivery on a back of a length outside off and Jadeja has read it like today's newspaper. Hangs back in his crease and scythes it past backward point!
clean strike! In the arc, and out of the park! Jadeja sits deep enough in his crease, gets under it and smashes it over long on!
length delivery just outside off stump. Dhoni winds up and slogs at it, squirting it off the inside edge towards fine leg
length delivery angled into middle and leg stump. Jadeja flicks it towards deep backward square leg and gets off the mark

Conway bites the dust too! Slower delivery on a length on off stump. This one just holds in the surface a touch and Conway does not get the timing he is after. Slices it and Aman runs to his right at long on and completes the catch comfortably! Another excellent Conway knock, though - it has set the foundation for another massive first-innings score!
low full toss outside off stump. Conway has a loose waft at it and sees the ball sneak past the bat

caught at long on! Slot ball on middle and leg stump, and Dube could have hit that anywhere. But on this occasion, he swings a little too early and gets it right off the bottom of the blade. The ball spoons up towards long on, where Lalit does the rest! Dube has done his job, though!
excellent yorker on leg stump. Dube cannot get underneath it and digs it out towards the bowler. Rare but vital dot ball!
full and down the leg side. Conway can only glance it straight to the sweeper at fine leg for a single
very high full toss down the leg side that Conway does well to get out of the way of. Called a No ball, rather unsurprisingly
back of a length delivery on off stump. Dube clears his front leg and heaves it towards long on for a single
oh my! In the slot, and that is always going to travel against Dube! Has a clean swing through the line and sends it soaring over the bowler's head!
yorker fired down the leg side. Dube lets it go and the umpire has no qualms in calling it a wide
Dube does not time it well but still gets six! Full toss on leg stump and that is easy pickings for Dube. Swings at it and muscles it over deep mid wicket!
yorker fired down the leg side. Conway gets some bat but cannot beat the fielder in the circle at short fine leg
low full toss just outside off stump. Dube drives it towards extra cover and collects another single
short delivery on off stump. Conway has a swipe at it and mistimes it towards deep square leg. Conway is livid with himself for mistiming that one!
six for Conway! Back of a length delivery angled into leg stump. Conway uses the pace and shovels it over deep square leg!
ouch! Length delivery angled into off stump. Conway looks for the scoop but seems to hit it straight into his helmet. That might sting!
edged and four! Length delivery just outside off stump. Conway has a swish across the line and gets a thick outside edge that flies past short third
back of a length delivery on off stump. Conway looks to repeat the stroke but this time, shanks it towards long on
what timing! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Conway goes back and just chips it over the bowler's head. The ball hits the turf and skips away past long off for four!
very full delivery outside off stump. Dube drives it towards deep extra cover for a single
another back of a length delivery way outside off. Dube leaves it alone as the umpire indulges in some more exercise
wild short delivery way outside off. Called a wide, unsurprisingly
Dube goes big! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Dube sits deep in his crease, winds up and pumps it over the bowler's head!
full and outside off stump. Conway looks to go inside out but chunks it off the inside half of the bat into the leg side
here is Conway for now! Length delivery darted into the stumps. Conway clears his front leg and smacks it over the bowler's head for four!
slower delivery that ends up as a full toss just outside off. Conway drills it towards long on for one
slower delivery that goes awry and slides down the leg side. Conway does not get bat on it as the umpire calls it a wide
short, wide and this time, Sakariya does not get away with it! Conway has all the time in the world to stand up on his toes and slash it over backward point
slow and short outside off stump. Dube cuts it towards deep cover point for a single

holes out to deep square leg! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Gaikwad tries to muscle it over deep square leg but just does not have enough pace to work with. He is slightly early into the stroke too and slices it. Rossouw settles under it on the fence and completes the catch. Sakariya is delighted but take nothing away from this knock - this has been simply stunning!
cutter on a length on leg stump. Gaikwad closes the bat face early and gets a leading edge that falls agonizingly short of backward point
high full toss. Conway manages to get it away and then looks at the square leg umpire. Does not get the No ball, though and has to settle for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gaikwad does not have much pace to work with and guides it straight to backward point
full delivery just outside off stump. Conway plants his front foot and drives it down the ground for one more run
four more! Fractionally short outside off stump. Conway picks the length early and dumps it over mid wicket for another boundary!
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Gaikwad drags it towards deep mid wicket for a single
short and outside off stump. Conway flat-bats it towards long off for one
what a shot! Full and slanted into the stumps. Conway plants his front foot and nonchalantly whips it over deep mid wicket!
Six more! Banged into the track on leg stump but the line allows Gaikwad to get inside it and hook it comfortably over short fine leg!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Conway does not quite time his pull stroke well and shanks it towards long on
dug into the track on leg stump. Gaikwad backs away and cuts it towards deep point for one more run
length delivery on off stump. Conway opens up his stance and tugs it towards mid wicket for one

back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that hurries onto Gaikwad. He is late on the stroke and cops a blow on the body for his troubles. Might have gotten a scratch before the ball hit him on the inside of the left knee
back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and dabs it towards backward point
looped up a touch on a length on leg stump. Conway has a swipe across the line but misses as the ball pings off the back thigh into the off side
quicker and flatter on a length on middle and leg stump. Gaikwad taps it towards deep mid wicket and collects a single
three sixes in the over! Flighted into the slot outside off and Gaikwad is not going to miss out! Gets into position and slams it over the bowler's head!
cleaner hit, and bigger hit! Full and this one is on the pads. Gaikwad gets his front foot out of the way and smears it over wide long on!
clears the fence again! Given a bit of air but this lands right in the slot on off stump. Gaikwad swings through the line and lifts it comfortably over the fielder at long off!
tossed up outside off stump. Conway reaches out for it and powers it towards long on for a single
off-pace delivery on a full length on middle and off stump. Conway works it towards deep mid wicket for one
edged but does not carry! Slower delivery on a length just outside off stump. Conway has a massive swish at it and gets an outside edge that lands in front of Salt
off-pace delivery on a length just outside off stump. Conway stabs it into the off side. Gaikwad wants the single and is sent back. He slips but manages to make it back in time
dug into the track outside off stump. Conway swipes at it and hits it towards deep backward square leg. Axar seems to lose it in the sun for a moment and can't pull it back in!
four more! Full and down the leg side, and that is asking for trouble with fine leg up. Conway uses the pace and helps it past short fine leg!
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Gaikwad gets forward and knocks it down the ground for one
full and hung outside off stump. Conway tries the reverse sweep but does not make any contact
full delivery just outside off stump. Gaikwad lunges forward and pushes it towards long off for a single. Gets to his fifty too, his third this season!
consecutive sixes! Another marginally short delivery at the stumps and Gaikwad is now camping on the back foot. Waits for it and thumps it over deep mid wicket!
Gaikwad breaks free! Fractionally short on leg stump and Gaikwad is all over it like a rash! Rocks back and pummels it high and long over deep mid wicket!
very full delivery on leg stump. Conway chalks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery at the stumps. Gaikwad makes room and punches it past extra cover for one
length delivery outside off stump. Gaikwad goes back and hacks it towards deep mid wicket
back of a length delivery on off stump. Conway hangs back and works it towards deep mid wicket
safe! Given a bit of air on a full length on middle and off stump. Gaikwad does not pick the googly and has a slog across the line. Gets it off the toe-end and it just evades short extra cover
marginally short on middle and leg stump. Conway hops back and punches it towards long on. Thinks about the second before settling for the single
googly on a length just outside off stump. Gaikwad lunges forward and dabs it towards backward point for one
short delivery on middle and off stump. Conway rocks onto the back foot and pulls it powerfully towards deep mid wicket. Just a single, though
length delivery on middle and leg stump that comes in with the arm. Gaikwad squirts it past short fine leg, where the fielder, while giving chase, misfields and concedes the second
length delivery outside off stump. Gaikwad advances and taps it towards short extra cover
length delivery on off stump. Gaikwad gives himself room but cuts it straight to the fielder at backward point
full delivery angled into leg stump. Gaikwad backs away a touch and chips it over extra cover for a couple of runs
full delivery hung outside off stump. Conway throws his hands at it and shanks it towards deep mid wicket
fired into the track on middle and leg stump. Gaikwad eases it towards deep mid wicket for one
full delivery on middle and leg stump. Gaikwad comes forward and flicks it towards deep mid wicket for a single
googly on a full length on middle and leg stump. Gaikwad has a stab at it and gets a thick outside edge that bobbles towards point
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Conway comes down the track and nudges it into the on side for one more run. Thought about the second initially before deciding against it just as quickly
flighted on a full length just outside off stump. Gaikwad lunges forward and pushes it towards deep cover point
short and dispatched! Drag-down outside off, and Gaikwad has all the time in the world to hop back and hammer it between long on and deep mid wicket!
full delivery on leg stump. Conway comes forward and turns it behind square on the leg side for a single
length delivery just outside off stump. Gaikwad presses half forward and dabs it towards backward point. That is the first over without a boundary so far this innings!
angled into the batter on leg stump. Gaikwad prods it towards short mid wicket. That might have been another slower delivery
slower bumper on leg stump. Gaikwad advances before opting to duck under it
slower delivery on a length outside off stump. Conway goes feeling for it and chunks it off the inside edge towards mid on for one
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Gaikwad pokes it towards mid off and gets across to the other end
slower delivery on a full length down the leg side. Gaikwad does not get bat on it but the ball might have brushed the pad because it has not been called a wide. No review either!
well well! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Conway shuffles across and looks to lap it but does not make any contact whatsoever
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Conway hangs back and defends it towards the bowler
regal! Half-volley outside off and Conway is not going to miss out. He springs forward and cracks it past mid off for four!
four more! Dug into the track on middle and leg stump. Conway gets inside the line early enough and helps it past short fine leg!
another off-pace delivery on a back of a length outside off. Gaikwad scuffs it towards backward point for a single
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Gaikwad waits in his crease and dabs it towards backward point
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gaikwad goes back and eases it towards mid on for one more run
length delivery just outside off stump. Conway drops it into the on side and ambles across to the other end
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gaikwad shimmies around his crease before punching it down the ground for a single
beautiful! Given just a bit of air but this lands right in the slot outside off stump. Gaikwad gets to the pitch of the ball and caresses it over the extra cover fence!
full delivery just outside off stump. Conway comes down the track and knocks it towards long on
full delivery just outside off stump. Gaikwad gives himself a bit of room and drives it towards long off for one
short, wide and punished! Too much width and it allows Conway to throw his hands at it and knife it past backward point for four!
four more! Full delivery angled into off stump. Conway comes out of his bunker again and flicks it over mid wicket!
length delivery outside off stump. Conway takes a step down the track and punches it past the bowler. Warner dives to his left and saves a certain boundary
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gaikwad uses the pace and tucks it off his hips towards deep square leg
banged into the track on leg stump. Gaikwad sizes up the length early and ducks underneath it. Called a wide for height, though
peach! Length delivery in the channel that pitches and nips away just a shade. Gaikwad has a nibble at it and is beaten on the outside
length delivery just outside off stump. Conway dabs it towards short third man, who misfields and ends up conceding a single
length delivery just outside off stump that continues with the arm. Gaikwad comes forward and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Conway hangs back and cuts it towards backward point for a single
lovely! Full delivery outside off stump. Conway is down the track in a flash, swings through the line and bangs it into the sightscreen! That is also the 1000th six in IPL 2023!
length delivery on middle and off stump. Gaikwad comes half forward and works it towards square leg for one
shot! Dragged down outside off stump. Gaikwad rocks onto the back foot and bisects the gap between deep mid wicket and long on to perfection!
tossed up on a full length on middle and off stump. Conway comes forward and pushes it down the ground to get off the mark
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Gaikwad gets onto the back foot and punches it towards cover point
shot! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Gaikwad lets the ball come to him before tucking it neatly off his hips through square leg for four!
back of a length delivery on off stump. Gaikwad gets up on his toes and defends it towards backward point
full delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Gaikwad comes forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
full delivery that swings big into the batter. Conway falls across a little and plays all over it as the ball pings off the pads towards fine leg for a leg bye
length delivery on leg stump that shapes in slightly. Gaikwad comes half forward and tucks it towards mid wicket to get off the mark

but he gets Sakariya this time! Back of a length delivery on leg stump that decks back sharply and catches Sakariya on the crease. He has a prod at it buts nowhere close to the ball as the ball cannons into his pads. The umpire raises his finger but Sakariya reviews! Hang on, this looks like a very good review. The ball pitched just outside leg, and Sakariya is not dismissed! But it does not matter, as far as the result is concerned. CSK win by 77 runs and march into the playoffs, yet again!

huge appeal, not given! And Dhoni reviews, with a smile on his face! Full delivery that might have just pitched outside leg before continuing with the arm. Sakariya plays down the wrong line and is pinned on the pads. The umpire says no, possibly because it might have pitched outside leg. And he is right. The ball indeed pitched outside leg, and Theekshana will not get a hat-trick today!

and Kuldeep bites the dust! Full delivery on middle and leg stump that nips back sharply. Kuldeep has no clue about it and plays down the wrong line. The ball thuds into the front pad and the umpire raises his finger! Kuldeep has reviewed this but he is already walking back to the pavilion! No bat involved, and as expected, the ball would have smashed into the stumps! Theekshana is now on a hat-trick!

Theekshana has his first! Full delivery that seems to swerve away from the batter late. Lalit tries to go inside out but gets it horribly wrong. Slices it and Moeen runs back from extra cover to gobble up the chance!
length delivery outside off stump. Lalit throws his hands at it and jabs it towards extra cover
yorker on middle and off stump. Lalit digs it out towards the bowler
full delivery just outside off stump. Lalit scuffs past the bowler and canters across to the other end
slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Lalit swipes at it and only connects with fresh air
sizzling yorker that hones in on the batter's toes. Nortje is late on the stroke and plays all over it as the ball pings off his padas into the leg side

holes out to long on! Excellent by Gaikwad and exceptional by Pathirana! Off-pace delivery on a full length just outside off stump. Warner, like Aman, does not pick it at all. Swings way too early and chips it towards long on. Gaikwad runs in from the fence, dives forward and hands Pathirana his second scalp of the evening!
full delivery just outside off stump. Warner plants his front foot and drills it straight to mid off
yorker outside off stump. Lalit presses forward and drives it towards deep cover point for one more run
full and slanted into leg stump. Lalit swishes and misses as the ball pings into his pads. Going down leg, though
slower bumper on leg stump. Lalit gets inside the line of the ball and hooks it over short fine leg. Jadeja comes around from deep backward square leg, though, and keeps it down to two
short outside off stump. Warner cuts it towards deep backward point and moves to 86
low full toss outside off stump. Warner takes a step across his stumps early and tries to access the off side but fails to get any bat on it
off-pace delivery on a length on leg stump. Lalit swings and misses as the ball trickles off his pads into the on side
very full delivery outside off stump. Warner uses the pace and glides it towards deep backward point for one more run
short and wide again. Warner cuts it towards deep cover point and retains strike for the next over
short and outside off stump. Lalit gets up on his toes and cuts it towards deep cover point for another run
full delivery just outside off stump. Lalit comes onto the front foot and drives it down the ground towards mid off
full and way outside off stump again. Pathirana will have to reload!
full toss on off stump. Warner opens his bat face and guides it down to a very fine deep backward point for a single
length delivery outside off stump. Lalit stands tall and punches it on the up towards deep cover point. Gets off the mark too
length delivery way outside off stump. Lalit lets it go as the umpire indulges in some more exercise

soft dismissal! Slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Aman has not picked the variation at all and is too early into his stroke. Dangles his bat eventually and spoons it up towards extra cover, where Moeen does the rest!
streaky! Low full toss slanted across the batter outside off. Warner throws his hands at it and gets just enough bat to bisect the keeper and short third man!
more runs for Warner! Slow and short outside off stump. Warner has all the time in the world to crack it over extra cover for four!
slower delivery on a full length on leg stump. Aman clears his front leg and heaves it towards deep mid wicket
gets it away! Yorker that is angled into leg stump. Aman gets his feet out of the way, gets his bat down in time and squeezes it past short fine leg for four!
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Warner sits back in his crease and cuts it towards extra cover for a single

another wide yorker. Warner advances, swings and misses. Does not get bat on it and called a wide by the umpire. Dhoni, for a moment, seemed interested in the caught behind but decides against the review
wide yorker that is nailed to perfection. Warner cannot do much with it and digs it out towards extra cover
full delivery just outside off stump. Aman sits deep in his crease and drives it straight to the fielder at extra cover
wild short delivery way outside off stump. Aman leaves it alone and Dhoni does well to get something behind it
short delivery on off stump. Aman is a tad hurried into his pull stroke and can only pick out the fielder at mid wicket
slower delivery on a full length outside off stump. Warner comes forward and eases it towards deep extra cover for another single
length delivery outside off stump. Aman throws his hands at it and toe-ends it down to third man for one
full and wide outside off stump. Warner opens his bat face and glides it straight to short third man. Just a single
very full delivery outside off stump. Warner tries to dab it fine but is late on the stroke. Makes no contact in the end
fired down the leg side. Aman lets it go and Dhoni fumbles too, allowing the batters to sneak in an additional run
slower delivery on a full length on off stump. Aman tips it into the off side and dashes across to the other end
length delivery just outside off stump. Aman comes onto the front foot and defends it towards backward point
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Aman dabs it towards backward point

Chahar gets Axar! Slower bumper outside off stump and this one just does not arrive. Axar has a swipe at it and tries to muscle it over long on but the lack of pace means that he picks out Gaikwad to perfection! DC slip further!
dug into the track on off stump. Warner backs away and punches it towards long off for one more run
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Axar works it behind square on the leg side for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Warner flat-bats it back to the bowler
brilliant! Full delivery fired across the batter outside off. Warner brings out the reverse and slams it over the third man fence!
Warner smashes it into the stands now! In the slot outside off stump. Warner plants his front foot and mousses it over cow corner!
four more! Too short, too wide, and Warner takes full toll. Sits back in his crease and carves it over extra cover!
length delivery just outside off stump. Axar hangs back and tugs it towards long on for one
Axar hits Jadeja for six! Length delivery on middle and off stump. Axar stands up tall and muscles it over the bowler's head for six!
another back of a length delivery on leg stump. Warner is again early into the pull and chalks it towards the keeper

oh! Dug into the track on leg stump and this one seems to hold in the surface. Warner swings too early and by the time the ball comes, his eyes are not on the ball. Cops a blow on the back of the shoulder
back fo a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Axar taps it into the leg side for a sharp single
short and wide outside off stump. Warner does well to reach it but can only clink it towards deep point
nearly! Back of a length delivery on off stump. Axar drops it towards backward point and Warner calls him through for the single. Warner might have been struggling with a direct hit

full toss fired way outside off stump. Axar lets it go, and it looks like the umpire wants to see if this has landed outside the cut strip, in which case, it would be deemed a No ball. They have stuck with the wide call for now!
shot! Full delivery just outside off stump. Axar plants his front foot and crunches it past extra cover for four!
length delivery on leg stump. Axar turns it behind square on the leg side and gets off the mark

Dhull perishes! Fired into the track on a length outside off stump. Dhull tries to tonk it into next week but loses his shape completely. The ball also grips in the surface a touch and spins away enough to take the outside edge and nestle in Deshpande's palms at backward point!
short and wide outside off stump. Warner flat-bats it towards long off for a single
length delivery outside off stump. Dhull reaches out for it and jabs it towards deep cover point for one more run
full and darted into the stumps. Warner hoicks it away towards deep backward square leg
full and fired outside off stump. Warner lets it go and this time, does not get the wide call. Seemed marginal!
length delivery just outside off stump. Warner comes half forward and dabs it towards short third man for one
full delivery on the pads. Warner nurdles it into the leg side and hares back for a sharp brace. Fifty for Warner too, this one has come off 32 balls!
full delivery outside off stump. Dhull advances, reaches out for it and drives it towards deep cover point
angled into off stump. Warner waits in his crease and heaves it away towards deep mid wicket
shot! Short and outside off stump. Warner picks the length early enough, lines it up and crashes it over extra cover for four!
safe! Full delivery outside off stump. Warner throws his hands at it and slices it just over extra cover for a couple of runs
full delivery on middle and off stump. Warner comes forward and knocks it down the ground for a single
back of a length delivery fired across the batter outside off. Warner has a swish at it but misses
In the slot again and Warner cashes in! Plants his front foot and smacks it over the bowler's head for four!
short and way outside off stump. Warner leaves it alone as the umpire calls it a wide
full and right in the slot outside off stump. Warner gets down on one knee and smears it over cow corner!
back of a length delivery on leg stump. Dhull goes back and works it towards deep backward square leg for one more run
short and fired way outside off, which is a riposte to Warner advancing. Reaches out for it and stabs it towards extra cover for a single
full and angled into the pads. Warner helps it round the corner and scampers across to the other end
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Warner cuts it nicely but cannot beat the twin fielders in the extra cover region
length delivery just outside off stump. Dhull skips down the track and flicks it towards long on for one
length delivery on middle and off stump that holds in the surface. Warner stabs it back to the bowler, who misfields and concedes a single
given a bit of air on a length on off stump. Warner advances and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length delivery on off stump. Dhull works it towards deep mid wicket and settles for a single
back of a length delivery fired into the pads. Dhull tucks it away towards deep mid wicket and collects a single
length delivery on middle and off stump. Warner opts to stay back before poking it down the ground for one
back of a length delivery on off stump. Dhull gets onto the back foot and punches it towards long on
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Warner swings it away towards deep backward square leg
full delivery just outside off stump. Dhull advances and pushes it towards long off for a single
and he gets greeted with a boundary! Short and wide outside off. Dhull throws his hands at it and slices it past backward point for four!
big shot! Dragged down slightly on middle and leg stump. Warner rocks onto the back foot and pounds it over the deep mid wicket fence!
full delivery just outside off stump. Dhull tips it down the ground and hares across to the other end to get off the mark
length delivery angled into middle and leg stump. Dhull tucks it away towards mid wicket
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Dhull stays back and cuts it towards backward point
length delivery just outside off stump. Dhull lunges forward and defends into the off side
oh! Full delivery on middle and leg stump that nips back. Warner has a nibble at it and squirts it off the inside edge towards short fine leg
back of a length delivery on off stump. Dhull walks down the track before dropping the ball into the on side

Rossouw departs first ball! One brings two for Chahar! Back of a length delivery outside off stump that sticks in the surface and just does not come on. Rossouw has a waft at it but is way too early into it, getting a thick inside edge that cannons into the stumps!

Salt falls! Cutter on a length just outside off stump and Salt's struggles come to an end. He tries to force it over the off side but because of the lack of pace, he can only slice it straight to extra cover! Chahar has a smile on his face but more importantly, he has another powerplay wicket for CSK!
short and wide outside off stump. Warner jabs it towards extra cover and scrambles across to the other end. Dives to make his ground but the throw is well wide of the mark
four more! Slower delivery that sits up to be hit on off stump. Warner obliges and thrashes it over mid on. One bounce and into the fence!
Warner breaks the shackles! Slower delivery dug into the track outside off stump. Warner marches down the track and slaps it flat over long on!
short and wide outside off stump. Warner scuffs it into the off side and trudges across to the other end
back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump. Warner is cramped for room and clinks it towards mid on
slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Warner picks out extra cover again with his back-foot punch
oh! Back of a length delivery on middle and leg stump that skids through. Warner looks for the pull but is beaten for pace. Makes no contact whatsoever
gets it away! Full and on the pads. Warner lets the ball come to him and shovels it past mid wicket for a much-needed boundary!
safe! Off-pace delivery into the track outside off stump. Salt is again too early into his stroke and shanks it past mid wicket for a single
back of a length delivery outside off stump. Some more fielding practice for the fielder at extra cover

terrific work by Conway! Back of a length delivery just outside off stump. Warner punches it crisply past extra cover. Conway gives chase on the fence, channels his inner Lionel Messi and stops a certain boundary with a bit of nifty footwork!
short and wide outside off stump. Warner gets up on his toes and laces his cut. Cannot beat extra cover, though
another slower delivery on a back of a length outside off stump. Warner drills it straight to extra cover. The fielder misfields and Warner thinks there is a single, only to be sent back
slower delivery on a back of a length on off stump. Salt advances and throws his hands at it. He is too early into the stroke, though, and drags it towards mid wicket
length delivery on middle and leg stump. Salt gets onto the front foot and taps it down the ground
full delivery just outside off stump. Warner comes onto the front foot and picks out one of two fielders stationed in the extra cover region
back of a length delivery on middle and off stump. Salt comes down the track and flat-bats it over the bowler. Does not time it very well, though, and only picks up a single to long on
length delivery slanted into off stump. Salt comes half forward and defends it back to the bowler

put a cape on Rayudu at mid off! Full delivery just outside off stump that seems to hold in the surface. Shaw tries to drive on the up but cannot keep his stroke down. The ball arrows towards mid off, where Rayudu flies to his right and takes a superb catch! DC have been stung early!
length delivery angled into the stumps again. Shaw defends it towards mid on with a straight bat
length delivery just outside off stump. Shaw has a jab at it and chunks it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on
jaffa! Length delivery in the channel that threatens to shape back in, only to pitch and nip away a shade. Warner has a nibble at it and is beaten all ends up!
length delivery angled across the batter outside off stump. Warner has a waft at it away from his body and gets beaten on the outside
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that sticks in the surface. Shaw closes his bat face early and gets a leading edge towards backward point. Excellent stop by Gaikwad in the ring!
shot! Back of a length delivery on leg stump. Shaw gets onto the back foot and clips it delightfully past square leg for four!
length delivery outside off stump. Shaw gets onto the front foot and punches it towards extra cover
back of a length delivery just outside off stump that shapes away. Shaw goes back and stabs it down the ground towards mid on
